release_notes:
FocusDefend v3.4.0 — Study Mode DND & Notification Architecture Upgrade:
• Dedicated Student Notification Center: Added full notification center screen (All, Study, Rewards, Guardian) with unread indicator badge on the student home header.
• Distraction-Free Study Mode: Automatic Android Do Not Disturb (DND) integration (INTERRUPTION_FILTER_PRIORITY) mutes distracting phone notifications at OS level, preserving only emergency Phone Calls and SMS.
• Hardware-Level Non-Essential App Shield: During active study sprints, any non-essential app opened is intercepted immediately with a return-to-study challenge overlay.
• Eliminated Floating Nav Bar Button Overlaps: Hidden subroutes (study-mode, quiz, tasks, unlock, notifications) suppress the floating tab bar completely, and main tab scroll views feature safe 140px bottom padding.
• Authentic Student Name Resolution: Completely replaced generic 'Hello, Student' with the student's real name (e.g. 'Hello, Aviral') derived from user profile, email username parsing, and onboarding identity.
• Real Curriculum Data Sync: Live synchronization with Supabase and local syllabus assignments tailored to student's actual class and focus subjects.
